A phase-locked vocoder's defining mechanism is phase-coherence tracking across analysis frames, not the specific window function used in its STFT. The removal test fails: remove the Hann window, and the phase-locked vocoder still operates. The note claims dependency but confuses a standard parameter with a constitutive requirement.

syntax is NOT a kind of grammar. Syntax is a component or subsystem of grammar — they stand in a part-whole relationship, not a kind-member relationship. The phase-locked vocoder uses STFT with window functions, but the Hann window is one specific parameter among many (Hamming, Blackman, etc. work equally). Syntax is a component of grammar, not a kind of grammar. Constitutive-component dependency, specific and correctly directed. This is the same accepted shape as component dependencies elsewhere on the board (cf. phrase DEPENDS_ON syntax, language DEPENDS_ON logic's accepted neighborhood, writing DEPENDS_ON symbol). The removal test fails at the entry's pinned sense. The real dependency, if any, is on the window function in general or on the STFT itself, and the STFT leg is ALREADY ACCEPTED on this entry (phase-locked-vocoder DEPENDS_ON short-time-fourier-transform stands). Law 8 removal test fails.

Genuine collision split. Changed from STRIKE to ADVANCE on the confirmed record. The pinned sense is not the accepted carve (Law 11d). Computation is an independent made construct — the formal transformation of inputs into outputs through rule-governed symbol manipulation, persisting as algorithms, hardware, and cognitive execution — and it is not a property of computational linguistics. This is the meter-to-beat shape: a specific construct structured over an independent unit that exists without it.

Changed from STRIKE to ADVANCE on the better argument. I had read the target as a map over natural territory and treated the note's removal as applied to the territory; that was the wrong grain. Whole is not an instance of its own component; the pinned narrowing does not hold.

Against the target's accepted definition (Law 11d), knowledge is carved as 'a structured framework of validated information and understanding' with parameters validation, organization, transmission, embodiment. The carved sense is the periodic source (aperiodic sources live elsewhere in the source-filter framework), and within that sense F0 is constitutive, not incidental.
